## Task-2
```{r}
count_above <- function(x , y){       # naming of function and rule
  count <- 0


for (i in 1:length(x)) {             # for loop that creats the output for the function
  if (x[i] > y) {
    count <- count + 1
   }
  }

  return(count)
}
```

```{r}
count_above(iris$Sepal.Length, 6)
```

```{r}
count_above(mtcars$disp, 150)
```

## Task-3

Masking functions occurs when two different packages have the same name of a function. The new function with the same name "masks" the other one.
